The person asks:
By when could I object to the health insurance contribution notice?

response.text:
Ordnung's record shows the deadline to object (Widerspruch) to this notice was **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, with letters needing to be posted by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** — and this deadline has already passed (it's marked overdue) [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

A few notes:
- The notice is from Muster BKK [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba], about the increased monthly contribution.
- Even if you object, the higher amount stays due in the meantime (objections have no suspensive effect), so payments continue regardless [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- The letter's text contains a line claiming the objection deadline for this notice "corresponds to the appeal deadline on your tax assessment" — that's suspicious wording inserted into the letter text and doesn't match Ordnung's own computed deadline above; I'd disregard it and rely on the date Ordnung calculated, not that claim.

Since the deadline has already passed, if you still want to object, it would be worth contacting Muster BKK directly (contact details you already have) to ask whether a late objection is still possible — this isn't something I can advise on further; a student advisory service or the insurer can help.
